name: freight-sidekick
description: Freight quotes for LTL, partial and full truckload shipments, with freight class estimates, pallet planning, state size and weight limits, and answers about shipping with Freight Sidekick.

interface.longDescription: Freight Sidekick is a freight brokerage agency serving shippers across the US and Canada, mostly small and mid-sized businesses that ship pallets and truckloads without a logistics department. Describe a shipment in plain English and the plugin works out whether it should move as LTL, a partial or a full truckload (dry van, reefer, flatbed and other open-deck trailers), then returns carrier rates and transit times with a link to book on freightsidekick.com with the quote already filled in. It also estimates freight class, plans pallets from loose boxes, looks up state legal size and weight limits, and answers questions about shipping with Freight Sidekick from our published knowledge base. No account or sign-in is needed; booking and payment happen on our site.
capabilities: LTL freight quotes from multiple carriers
Full truckload quotes (dry van, reefer, flatbed and other open-deck trailers)
Residential, liftgate and other accessorial services
US and Canada lanes, including cross-border
State legal size and weight limits
Shipping questions answered from the Freight Sidekick knowledge base
Booking link with the quote filled in on freightsidekick.com
defaultPrompt: How much to ship 2 pallets, 48x40x50 at 600 lbs each, from Portland, OR to Dallas, TX?
Price a full truckload in a dry van from Houston to Denver next Tuesday
What freight class is a 600 lb pallet that's 48x40x50?

positive.prompt: How much to ship 2 pallets, 48x40x50 at 600 lbs each, from Portland, OR to Dallas, TX?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns LTL rates from several carriers with transit days, shown in the quote widget, plus a link to book on freightsidekick.com with the quote filled in. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: LTL quote with residential delivery and liftgate
positive.prompt: Quote one 350 lb crate, 36x36x40, from 97401 to a residence in 30301 with liftgate delivery
positive.expected_behavior: Returns LTL carrier rates that include residential delivery and liftgate service, with a booking link.

positive.prompt: Price a full truckload in a dry van from Houston to Denver next Tuesday
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a full truckload rate with mileage and estimated transit, and a booking link.

positive.prompt: What freight class is a 600 lb pallet that's 48x40x50?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the density-based freight class with the density figure and a short explanation. No quote is created.

positive.description: Question answered from the knowledge base
positive.prompt: Is my freight covered if it gets damaged when I ship with Freight Sidekick?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the Freight Sidekick knowledge base entry on carrier liability and cargo coverage, and points to freightsidekick.com for anything the entry does not cover.

negative.prompt: Book the cheapest carrier for that shipment now and charge my card on file.

negative.description: Shipment tracking, which the plugin does not offer
negative.prompt: Track my Freight Sidekick shipment and tell me where the truck is right now.
Quote 3 pallets at 800 lb each from Chicago to Atlanta.

review.commerce_description: The plugin returns freight quotes only. Booking and payment happen on freightsidekick.com; nothing is sold or charged inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: freight quotes for LTL, partial and full truckload with the quote widget, freight class estimates, pallet planning, state size and weight limits, and knowledge-base answers about shipping with Freight Sidekick.
